name: SLVEST
recent: Solarvest 公布 2026 财年第二季净利按年增长 34.8% 至 RM25.25 million，并称能源农场与新项目贡献增加。同期公司签署谅解备忘录，且雇员购股权计划（ESOS）持续行使使股本小幅增加。大股东 Prudential PLC 近期多次申报权益变动。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 17 日签署谅解备忘录（MOU）。
2026 财年第二季净利按年增长 34.8% 至 RM25.25 million，公司称录得纪录季度盈利。
Prudential PLC 于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报成为/变动大股东权益。
risks: 董事 Dato' Chong Chun Shiong 于 2026 年 10 月 6 日增持 6,000,000 股，同日董事 Lim Chin Siu 与 Tan Chyi Boon 各减持 3,000,000 股。
首席运营官 Yap Pei Koon 于 2026 年 10 月 9 日行使 ESOS 后减持 55,000 股。
Urusharta Jamaah Sdn. Bhd. 于 2026 年 10 月 8 日申报不再是大股东。
earnings: 最新季度（2026-06-30）营收 RM155.94 million，按年增 13.2%，按季减 42.0%；净利 RM19.02 million，按年增 19.8%，按季减 21.3%；净利率 12.2%，高于上季的 9.0%。

recent_en: Solarvest reported a 34.8% year-on-year rise in 2Q net profit to RM25.25 million, citing higher contributions from energy farms and new projects. It also signed a memorandum of understanding and continued to see small share capital increases from ESOS exercises. Substantial shareholder Prudential PLC made several changes-in-interest filings recently.
notable_en: The company signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on 17 November 2026.
2Q FY2026 net profit rose 34.8% year-on-year to RM25.25 million, which the company described as record quarterly earnings.
Prudential PLC made multiple filings on becoming/changing its substantial shareholder interest between October and November 2026.
risks_en: Director Dato' Chong Chun Shiong acquired 6,000,000 shares on 6 October 2026, while directors Lim Chin Siu and Tan Chyi Boon each disposed of 3,000,000 shares the same day.
Chief Operating Officer Yap Pei Koon disposed of 55,000 shares on 9 October 2026 after exercising ESOS.
Urusharta Jamaah Sdn. Bhd. filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 8 October 2026.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was RM155.94 million, up 13.2% year-on-year but down 42.0% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM19.02 million, up 19.8% year-on-year but down 21.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 12.2% versus 9.0% in the prior quarter.
